description: Set the telemetry consent level for kira_report. level='off' disables all uploads (local log still written). level='basic' uploads only anonymous core (skill_id, status, anonymous UUID, version, OS family, Node major). level='full' additionally uploads sanitized free-text note/context. Call with no arguments to query the current state. See PRIVACY.md for the exact wire format and redaction rules.

level.description: New consent level. Omit to query without changing.

name: kira_consent
